tasks.goal: Implement createLimiter({ capacity, refillPerSecond, now }) in src/index.js. It returns an object with tryTake(n = 1). The bucket starts full. now() returns milliseconds. Tokens refill continuously, fractions count, up to capacity. tryTake(n) returns true and removes n tokens only when at least n tokens are available; otherwise it returns false and removes nothing. An n larger than capacity is always refused. If the clock goes backwards, do not refill and do not throw. Throw a RangeError when capacity is not positive or refillPerSecond is negative.

Implement topoSort(edges) in src/index.js. edges is an array of [from, to] string pairs meaning from must come before to. Return every node that appears in an edge, in a valid order. Whenever several nodes are available, take the smallest one in ascending string order, so the result is deterministic. Duplicate edges are allowed. A self edge [a, a] is a cycle. On a cycle throw an Error with the message 'cycle: n1 -> n2 -> ... -> n1', naming one cycle that starts and ends at its smallest node; when there are several cycles, report the one that contains the smallest node that lies on any cycle.

Implement applyDiscount(cents, percent) in src/index.js. It returns the price in whole cents after taking percent off, and it rounds the discounted amount DOWN to a whole cent (floor), never to the nearest. Throw a RangeError when percent is below 0 or above 100.
